id_scheme: question_id = q_ + sha256(json[dataset, revision, split, NFC whitespace-collapsed text])[:20]; text_hash = sha256(normalised text)[:20]
selection: fresh MATH-Train questions (not exposed, level 1-5, text not in MATH-500), per level, ordered by sha256(salt|question_id), cut into consecutive blocks in the order of BLOCKS

checks.caveat: overlap is exact-text only; reworded or renumbered variants of a problem are not detected. loader_index is a convenience for joining with old artifacts; the question_id is authoritative and must be recomputed from the loaded text before a question is used.

math_train_exposed.use: never for fitting, selection or evaluation of the new study; history only

math_train_smoke.use: correctness and runtime profiling only; not a quality claim

math_train_calibration.use: fit value tables, cost models and stopping rules

math_train_confirmation_reserve.use: locked: generate candidates only after the policy is frozen

gsm8k_test.use: final evaluation, configurations frozen first; exposed items are reported, not hidden
gsm8k_test.prior_use: the whole split was evaluated repeatedly by the June-October Qwen experiments; items tagged looped_pilots_n200 were also run on Ouro

math500_test.prior_use: the whole split was evaluated by the June-October Qwen experiments; no Ouro run has used it
